svg.aria-label: Symlink policy across check and scan
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Symlink policy across check and scan
svg.desc: The new symlink module sits between the check dispatch and the filesystem, and between the scan walk and the filesystem. Both callers now ask it what a link means instead of skipping it.

g.text: CLI ENTRY · OSF CHECK / OSF SCAN
